rows.ja: 融資・受託の取引先(相手の資料に記載)
rows.en: Borrowers & trustee clients (named in their filings)

relations.text: Pro-Dexが10-Kで、買収資金665万ドルを借りた相手として挙げる
relations.text_en: Pro-Dex borrowed $6.65 million from UMB Bank for an acquisition

source.label: Pro-Dex 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: The aggregate purchase price was $ 8,650,000 of which $ 6,650,000 was paid in cash through a new term loan (Term Loan D) we borrowed from UMB Bank, N.A.

relations.text: INNOVATEが10-Kで、鉄骨子会社DBMGの借入契約の相手として挙げる(2025年5月)
relations.text_en: INNOVATE names UMB Bank in the May 2025 credit agreement of its DBMG unit

source.label: INNOVATE 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On May 20, 2025, DBMG entered into an Amended and Restated Credit agreement (the "DBMG Credit Agreement"), with the lenders which are party thereto from time to time (each a "Lender" and collectively the "Lenders") and UMB BANK, N.A. ("UMB").

companies.name: ブリッジャー・エアロスペース

relations.text: Bridger Aerospaceが10-Kで、消火機4機の購入資金を借りた相手として挙げる
relations.text_en: Bridger Aerospace financed four Kodiak aircraft with a UMB credit facility

source.label: Bridger Aerospace 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 3, 2020, the Company entered into a credit facility with UMB to finance in part the purchase of four Daher Kodiak aircraft.

companies.name: アムテック・システムズ

relations.text: Amtechが10-Kで、2024年9月まで使っていた借入枠の相手として挙げる
relations.text_en: Amtech paid off and ended its UMB Bank credit facility in September 2024

source.label: Amtech Systems 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: We paid off and terminated our existing credit facility with UMB Bank in September 2024.

relations.text: OppFiが10-Kで、1.5億ドルの借入枠の相手として挙げる(入金の受け皿もUMBの口座)
relations.text_en: OppFi had a $150 million revolving facility with UMB Bank, which also held its collection account

source.label: OppFi 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On December 14, 2022, Opportunity Funding SPE IX, LLC entered into the Prior SPV IX Agreement with UMB Bank N.A. that provided maximum borrowings of $ 150.0 million.

companies.name: ダイバーシファイド・エナジー

relations.text: Diversified Energyが10-Kで、証券化債券の受託銀行として挙げる
relations.text_en: Diversified Energy names UMB Bank indenture trustee of its securitization notes

source.label: Diversified Energy 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: • Indenture, dated October 27, 2022, among Diversified ABS Phase VI LLC, as issuer, Diversified ABS VI Upstream LLC and Oaktree ABS VI Upstream LLC, as guarantors and UMB Bank, N.A., as indenture trustee and securities intermediary.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
